Export/sql_metadata.name: Export related metadata from phpMyAdmin configuration storage

Export/sql_drop_table.name: Add DROP TABLE / VIEW / PROCEDURE / FUNCTION / EVENT / TRIGGER

Export/sql_if_not_exists.name: Add IF NOT EXISTS (less efficient as indexes will be generated during table creation)

Export/sql_backquotes.name: Enclose table and column names with backquotes

Export/sql_insert_syntax.name: Syntax to use when inserting data

Export/csv_columns.name: Put columns names in the first row

Export/excel_columns.name: Put columns names in the first row

VersionCheck.name: Version check
VersionCheck.desc: Enables check for latest version on main phpMyAdmin page.

NaturalOrder.name: Natural order
NaturalOrder.desc: Use natural order for sorting table and database names.

LoginCookieValidity.name: Login cookie validity
LoginCookieValidity.desc: Define how long (in seconds) a login cookie is valid.

SkipLockedTables.name: Skip locked tables
SkipLockedTables.desc: Mark used tables and make it possible to show databases with locked tables.

DisableMultiTableMaintenance.name: Disable multi table maintenance
DisableMultiTableMaintenance.desc: Disable the table maintenance mass operations, like optimizing or repairing the selected tables of a database.

ShowHint.name: Show hint
ShowHint.desc: Whether to show hint or not.

SendErrorReports.name: Send error reports
SendErrorReports.desc: Choose the default action when sending error reports.

ConsoleEnterExecutes.name: Enter executes queries in console
ConsoleEnterExecutes.desc: Queries are executed by pressing Enter (instead of Ctrl+Enter). New lines will be inserted with Shift+Enter.

MaxDbList.name: Maximum databases
MaxDbList.desc: Maximum number of databases displayed in database list.
MaxDbList.cmt: Users cannot set a higher value

MaxTableList.name: Maximum tables
MaxTableList.desc: Maximum number of tables displayed in table list.
MaxTableList.cmt: Users cannot set a higher value

CharEditing.name: CHAR columns editing
CharEditing.desc: Defines which type of editing controls should be used for CHAR and VARCHAR columns; [kbd]input[/kbd] - allows limiting of input length, [kbd]textarea[/kbd] - allows newlines in columns.

MinSizeForInputField.name: Minimum size for input field
MinSizeForInputField.desc: Defines the minimum size for input fields generated for CHAR and VARCHAR columns.

MaxSizeForInputField.name: Maximum size for input field
MaxSizeForInputField.desc: Defines the maximum size for input fields generated for CHAR and VARCHAR columns.

CharTextareaCols.name: CHAR textarea columns
CharTextareaCols.desc: Number of columns for CHAR/VARCHAR textareas.

CharTextareaRows.name: CHAR textarea rows
CharTextareaRows.desc: Number of rows for CHAR/VARCHAR textareas.

TextareaCols.name: Textarea columns
TextareaCols.desc: Textarea size (columns) in edit mode, this value will be emphasized for SQL query textareas (*2).

TextareaRows.name: Textarea rows
TextareaRows.desc: Textarea size (rows) in edit mode, this value will be emphasized for SQL query textareas (*2).

LongtextDoubleTextarea.name: Bigger textarea for LONGTEXT
LongtextDoubleTextarea.desc: Double size of textarea for LONGTEXT columns.

TitleDefault.name: Default title
TitleDefault.desc: Title of browser window when nothing is selected.

TitleTable.name: Table
TitleTable.desc: Title of browser window when a table is selected.

TitleDatabase.name: Database
TitleDatabase.desc: Title of browser window when a database is selected.

TitleServer.name: Server
TitleServer.desc: Title of browser window when a server is selected.

PmaNoRelation_DisableWarning.name: Missing phpMyAdmin configuration storage tables
PmaNoRelation_DisableWarning.desc: Disable the default warning that is displayed on the database details Structure page if any of the required tables for the phpMyAdmin configuration storage could not be found.

LoginCookieValidityDisableWarning.name: Login cookie validity warning
LoginCookieValidityDisableWarning.desc: Disable the default warning that is displayed on the main page if the value of the PHP setting session.gc_maxlifetime is less than the value of `LoginCookieValidity`.

ReservedWordDisableWarning.name: MySQL reserved word warning
ReservedWordDisableWarning.desc: Disable the default warning that is displayed on the Structure page if column names in a table are reserved MySQL words.

Console/EnterExecutes.name: Execute queries on Enter and insert new line with Shift+Enter

UploadDir.name: Upload directory
UploadDir.desc: Directory on server where you can upload files for import.

SaveDir.name: Save directory
SaveDir.desc: Directory where exports can be saved on server.

RecodingEngine.name: Recoding engine
RecodingEngine.desc: Select which functions will be used for character set conversion.

ZipDump.name: ZIP
ZipDump.desc: Enable ZIP compression for import and export operations.

GZipDump.name: GZip
GZipDump.desc: Enable gzip compression for import and export operations.

BZipDump.name: Bzip2
BZipDump.desc: Enable bzip2 compression for import operations.

CompressOnFly.name: Compress on the fly
CompressOnFly.desc: Compress gzip exports on the fly without the need for much memory; if you encounter problems with created gzip files disable this feature.

blowfish_secret.name: Blowfish secret
blowfish_secret.desc: Secret passphrase used for encrypting cookies in [kbd]cookie[/kbd] authentication.

TrustedProxies.name: List of trusted proxies for IP allow/deny
TrustedProxies.desc: Input proxies as [kbd]IP: trusted HTTP header[/kbd]. The following example specifies that phpMyAdmin should trust a HTTP_X_FORWARDED_FOR (X-Forwarded-For) header coming from the proxy 1.2.3.4:[br][kbd]1.2.3.4: HTTP_X_FORWARDED_FOR[/kbd].

AllowUserDropDatabase.name: Show "Drop database" link to normal users

AllowArbitraryServer.name: Allow login to any MySQL server
AllowArbitraryServer.desc: If enabled, user can enter any MySQL server in login form for cookie auth.

ArbitraryServerRegexp.name: Restrict login to MySQL server
ArbitraryServerRegexp.desc: Restricts the MySQL servers the user can enter when a login to an arbitrary MySQL server is enabled by matching the IP or hostname of the MySQL server to the given regular expression.

LoginCookieRecall.name: Recall user name
LoginCookieRecall.desc: Define whether the previous login should be recalled or not in [kbd]cookie[/kbd] authentication mode.

LoginCookieStore.name: Login cookie store
LoginCookieStore.desc: Defines how long (in seconds) a login cookie should be stored in browser. The default of 0 means that it will be kept for the existing session only, and will be deleted as soon as you close the browser window. This is recommended for non-trusted environments.

LoginCookieDeleteAll.name: Delete all cookies on logout
LoginCookieDeleteAll.desc: If TRUE, logout deletes cookies for all servers; when set to FALSE, logout only occurs for the current server. Setting this to FALSE makes it easy to forget to log out from other servers when connected to multiple servers.

CaptchaLoginPublicKey.name: Public key for reCAPTCHA
CaptchaLoginPublicKey.desc: Enter your public key for the reCAPTCHA service on your domain.

CaptchaLoginPrivateKey.name: Private key for reCAPTCHA
CaptchaLoginPrivateKey.desc: Enter your private key for your domain reCAPTCHA service.

CaptchaSiteVerifyURL.name: URL for reCAPTCHA siteverify
CaptchaSiteVerifyURL.desc: Enter your siteverify URL for your reCAPTCHA service.

UserprefsDeveloperTab.name: Enable the Developer tab in settings
UserprefsDeveloperTab.desc: When disabled, users cannot set any of the options below, regardless of the checkbox on the right.

DBG/sql.name: Debug SQL
DBG/sql.desc: Log SQL queries and their execution time, to be displayed in the console

PersistentConnections.name: Persistent connections
PersistentConnections.desc: Use persistent connections to MySQL databases.

ExecTimeLimit.name: Maximum execution time
ExecTimeLimit.desc: Set the number of seconds a script is allowed to run ([kbd]0[/kbd] for no limit).

MemoryLimit.name: Memory limit
MemoryLimit.desc: The number of bytes a script is allowed to allocate, e.g. [kbd]32M[/kbd] ([kbd]-1[/kbd] for no limit and [kbd]0[/kbd] for no change).

UseDbSearch.name: Use database search
UseDbSearch.desc: Allow for searching inside the entire database.

ProxyUrl.name: Proxy URL
ProxyUrl.desc: The URL of the proxy to be used when retrieving the information about the latest version of phpMyAdmin, or when submitting error reports. You need this if the server where phpMyAdmin is installed does not have direct access to the Internet. The format is: "hostname:portnumber".

ProxyUser.name: Proxy username
ProxyUser.desc: The username for authenticating with the proxy. By default, no authentication is performed. If a username is supplied, Basic Authentication will be performed. No other types of authentication are currently supported.

ProxyPass.name: Proxy password
ProxyPass.desc: The password for authenticating with the proxy.

AllowThirdPartyFraming.name: Allow third party framing
AllowThirdPartyFraming.desc: Enabling this allows a page located on a different domain to call phpMyAdmin inside a frame, and is a potential [strong]security hole[/strong] allowing cross-frame scripting (XSS) attacks.

ZeroConf.name: Enable Zero Configuration mode
ZeroConf.desc: Enable Zero Configuration mode which lets you set up phpMyAdmin configuration storage tables automatically.

Import/format.name: Format of imported file
Import/format.desc: Default format; be aware that this list depends on location (database, table) and only SQL is always available.

Import/allow_interrupt.name: Partial import: allow interrupt
Import/allow_interrupt.desc: Allow interrupt of import in case script detects it is close to time limit. This might be a good way to import large files, however it can break transactions.

Import/skip_queries.name: Partial import: skip queries
Import/skip_queries.desc: Number of queries to skip from start.

enable_drag_drop_import.name: Enable drag and drop import
enable_drag_drop_import.desc: Uncheck the checkbox to disable drag and drop import

Import/sql_no_auto_value_on_zero.name: Do not use AUTO_INCREMENT for zero values

Import/csv_replace.name: Add ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE
Import/csv_replace.desc: Update data when duplicate keys found on import

Import/csv_ignore.name: Do not abort on INSERT error

Import/ldi_replace.name: Add ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE
Import/ldi_replace.desc: Update data when duplicate keys found on import

Import/ldi_ignore.name: Do not abort on INSERT error

Import/ods_recognize_percentages.name: Import percentages as proper decimals (12.00% to .12)

ShowStats.name: Show statistics
ShowStats.desc: Allow to display database and table statistics (e.g. space usage).

ShowChgPassword.name: Show password change form
ShowChgPassword.desc: Please note that enabling this has no effect with [kbd]config[/kbd] authentication mode because the password is hard coded in the configuration file; this does not limit the ability to execute the same command directly.

ShowDbStructureCharset.name: Show table charset
ShowDbStructureCharset.desc: Show or hide a column displaying the charset for all tables.

ShowDbStructureComment.name: Show table comments
ShowDbStructureComment.desc: Show or hide a column displaying the comments for all tables.

ShowDbStructureCreation.name: Show creation timestamp
ShowDbStructureCreation.desc: Show or hide a column displaying the Creation timestamp for all tables.

ShowDbStructureLastUpdate.name: Show last update timestamp
ShowDbStructureLastUpdate.desc: Show or hide a column displaying the Last update timestamp for all tables.

ShowDbStructureLastCheck.name: Show last check timestamp
ShowDbStructureLastCheck.desc: Show or hide a column displaying the Last check timestamp for all tables.

HideStructureActions.name: Hide table structure actions
HideStructureActions.desc: Whether the table structure actions should be hidden.

ShowColumnComments.name: Show column comments
ShowColumnComments.desc: Whether column comments should be shown in table structure view

DefaultTransformations/Hex.name: Default transformations for Hex
DefaultTransformations/Hex.desc: Values for options list for default transformations. These will be overwritten if transformation is filled in at table structure page.

DefaultTransformations/Substring.name: Default transformations for Substring
DefaultTransformations/Substring.desc: Values for options list for default transformations. These will be overwritten if transformation is filled in at table structure page.

DefaultTransformations/Bool2Text.name: Default transformations for Bool2Text
DefaultTransformations/Bool2Text.desc: Values for options list for default transformations. These will be overwritten if transformation is filled in at table structure page.

DefaultTransformations/External.name: Default transformations for External
DefaultTransformations/External.desc: Values for options list for default transformations. These will be overwritten if transformation is filled in at table structure page.

DefaultTransformations/PreApPend.name: Default transformations for PreApPend
DefaultTransformations/PreApPend.desc: Values for options list for default transformations. These will be overwritten if transformation is filled in at table structure page.

DefaultTransformations/DateFormat.name: Default transformations for DateFormat
DefaultTransformations/DateFormat.desc: Values for options list for default transformations. These will be overwritten if transformation is filled in at table structure page.

DefaultTransformations/Inline.name: Default transformations for Inline
DefaultTransformations/Inline.desc: Values for options list for default transformations. These will be overwritten if transformation is filled in at table structure page.

DefaultTransformations/TextImageLink.name: Default transformations for TextImageLink
DefaultTransformations/TextImageLink.desc: Values for options list for default transformations. These will be overwritten if transformation is filled in at table structure page.

DefaultTransformations/TextLink.name: Default transformations for TextLink
DefaultTransformations/TextLink.desc: Values for options list for default transformations. These will be overwritten if transformation is filled in at table structure page.

TableNavigationLinksMode.name: Table navigation bar
TableNavigationLinksMode.desc: Use only icons, only text or both.

ActionLinksMode.name: How to display various action links
ActionLinksMode.desc: Use only icons, only text or both.

ShowAll.name: Allow to display all the rows
ShowAll.desc: Whether a user should be displayed a "show all (rows)" button.

MaxRows.name: Maximum number of rows to display
MaxRows.desc: Number of rows displayed when browsing a result set. If the result set contains more rows, "Previous" and "Next" links will be shown.

Order.name: Default sorting order
Order.desc: [kbd]SMART[/kbd] - i.e. descending order for columns of type TIME, DATE, DATETIME and TIMESTAMP, ascending order otherwise.

BrowsePointerEnable.name: Highlight pointer
BrowsePointerEnable.desc: Highlight row pointed by the mouse cursor.

SaveCellsAtOnce.name: Grid editing: save all edited cells at once

RepeatCells.name: Repeat headers
RepeatCells.desc: Repeat the headers every X cells, [kbd]0[/kbd] deactivates this feature.

LimitChars.name: Limit column characters
LimitChars.desc: Maximum number of characters shown in any non-numeric column on browse view.

RowActionLinks.name: Where to show the table row links
RowActionLinks.desc: These are Edit, Copy and Delete links.

RowActionLinksWithoutUnique.name: Show row links anyway
RowActionLinksWithoutUnique.desc: Whether to show row links even in the absence of a unique key.

TablePrimaryKeyOrder.name: Primary key default sort order
TablePrimaryKeyOrder.desc: Default sort order for tables with a primary key.

RememberSorting.name: Remember table's sorting
RememberSorting.desc: When browsing tables, the sorting of each table is remembered.

ProtectBinary.name: Protect binary columns
ProtectBinary.desc: Disallow BLOB and BINARY columns from editing.

ShowFunctionFields.name: Show function fields
ShowFunctionFields.desc: Display the function fields in edit/insert mode.

ShowFieldTypesInDataEditView.name: Show field types
ShowFieldTypesInDataEditView.desc: Defines whether or not type fields should be initially displayed in edit/insert mode.

InsertRows.name: Number of inserted rows
InsertRows.desc: How many rows can be inserted at one time.

ForeignKeyDropdownOrder.name: Foreign key dropdown order
ForeignKeyDropdownOrder.desc: Sort order for items in a foreign-key dropdown box; [kbd]content[/kbd] is the referenced data, [kbd]id[/kbd] is the key value.

ForeignKeyMaxLimit.name: Foreign key limit
ForeignKeyMaxLimit.desc: A dropdown will be used if fewer items are present.

TabsMode.name: How to display the menu tabs
TabsMode.desc: Use only icons, only text or both.

DefaultTabServer.name: Default server tab
DefaultTabServer.desc: Tab that is displayed when entering a server.

DefaultTabDatabase.name: Default database tab
DefaultTabDatabase.desc: Tab that is displayed when entering a database.

DefaultTabTable.name: Default table tab
DefaultTabTable.desc: Tab that is displayed when entering a table.

ShowDatabasesNavigationAsTree.name: Show databases navigation as tree
ShowDatabasesNavigationAsTree.desc: In the navigation panel, replaces the database tree with a selector

NavigationLinkWithMainPanel.name: Link with main panel
NavigationLinkWithMainPanel.desc: Link with main panel by highlighting the current database or table.

NavigationLogoLink.name: Logo link URL
NavigationLogoLink.desc: URL where logo in the navigation panel will point to.

NavigationLogoLinkWindow.name: Logo link target
NavigationLogoLinkWindow.desc: Open the linked page in the main window ([code]main[/code]) or in a new one ([code]new[/code]).

NavigationTreePointerEnable.name: Enable highlighting
NavigationTreePointerEnable.desc: Highlight server under the mouse cursor.

FirstLevelNavigationItems.name: Maximum items on first level
FirstLevelNavigationItems.desc: The number of items that can be displayed on each page on the first level of the navigation tree.

NavigationTreeDisplayItemFilterMinimum.name: Minimum number of items to display the filter box
NavigationTreeDisplayItemFilterMinimum.desc: Defines the minimum number of items (tables, views, routines and events) to display a filter box.

NumRecentTables.name: Recently used tables
NumRecentTables.desc: Maximum number of recently used tables; set 0 to disable.

NumFavoriteTables.name: Favorite tables
NumFavoriteTables.desc: Maximum number of favorite tables; set 0 to disable.

NavigationWidth.name: Navigation panel width
NavigationWidth.desc: Set to 0 to collapse navigation panel.

MaxNavigationItems.name: Maximum items in branch
MaxNavigationItems.desc: The number of items that can be displayed on each page of the navigation tree.

NavigationTreeEnableGrouping.name: Group items in the tree
NavigationTreeEnableGrouping.desc: Group items in the navigation tree (determined by the separator defined in the Databases and Tables tabs above).

NavigationTreeEnableExpansion.name: Enable navigation tree expansion
NavigationTreeEnableExpansion.desc: Whether to offer the possibility of tree expansion in the navigation panel.

NavigationTreeShowTables.name: Show tables in tree
NavigationTreeShowTables.desc: Whether to show tables under database in the navigation tree

NavigationTreeShowViews.name: Show views in tree
NavigationTreeShowViews.desc: Whether to show views under database in the navigation tree

NavigationTreeShowFunctions.name: Show functions in tree
NavigationTreeShowFunctions.desc: Whether to show functions under database in the navigation tree

NavigationTreeShowProcedures.name: Show procedures in tree
NavigationTreeShowProcedures.desc: Whether to show procedures under database in the navigation tree

NavigationTreeShowEvents.name: Show events in tree
NavigationTreeShowEvents.desc: Whether to show events under database in the navigation tree

NavigationTreeAutoexpandSingleDb.name: Expand single database
NavigationTreeAutoexpandSingleDb.desc: Whether to expand single database in the navigation tree automatically.

NavigationDisplayServers.name: Display servers selection
NavigationDisplayServers.desc: Display server choice at the top of the navigation panel.

DisplayServersList.name: Display servers as a list
DisplayServersList.desc: Show server listing as a list instead of a drop down.

NavigationTreeDisplayDbFilterMinimum.name: Minimum number of databases to display the database filter box

NavigationTreeDbSeparator.name: Database tree separator
NavigationTreeDbSeparator.desc: String that separates databases into different tree levels.

NavigationTreeDefaultTabTable2.name: Target for second quick access icon

NavigationTreeTableSeparator.name: Table tree separator
NavigationTreeTableSeparator.desc: String that separates tables into different tree levels.

Servers/1/verbose.name: Verbose name of this server
Servers/1/verbose.desc: A user-friendly description of this server. Leave blank to display the hostname instead.

Servers/1/host.name: Server hostname
Servers/1/host.desc: Hostname where MySQL server is running.

Servers/1/port.name: Server port
Servers/1/port.desc: Port on which MySQL server is listening, leave empty for default.

Servers/1/socket.name: Server socket
Servers/1/socket.desc: Socket on which MySQL server is listening, leave empty for default.

Servers/1/ssl.name: Use SSL
Servers/1/ssl.desc: Enable SSL for connection to MySQL server.

Servers/1/user.name: User for config auth
Servers/1/user.desc: Leave empty if not using config auth.

Servers/1/password.name: Password for config auth
Servers/1/password.desc: Leave empty if not using config auth.

Servers/1/auth_http_realm.name: HTTP Realm
Servers/1/auth_http_realm.desc: HTTP Basic Auth Realm name to display when doing HTTP Auth.

Servers/1/only_db.name: Show only listed databases
Servers/1/only_db.desc: You can use MySQL wildcard characters (% and _), escape them if you want to use their literal instances, i.e. use [kbd]'my\_db'[/kbd] and not [kbd]'my_db'[/kbd].

Servers/1/DisableIS.name: Disable use of INFORMATION_SCHEMA
Servers/1/DisableIS.desc: More information on [a@https://github.com/phpmyadmin/phpmyadmin/issues/8970]phpMyAdmin issue tracker[/a] and [a@https://bugs.mysql.com/19588]MySQL Bugs[/a]

Servers/1/SessionTimeZone.name: Session timezone
Servers/1/SessionTimeZone.desc: Sets the effective timezone; possibly different than the one from your database server

Servers/1/pmadb.name: Database name
Servers/1/pmadb.desc: Database used for relations, bookmarks, and PDF features. See [doc@linked-tables]pmadb[/doc] for complete information. Leave blank for no support. Suggested: [kbd]phpmyadmin[/kbd].

Servers/1/controlhost.name: Control host
Servers/1/controlhost.desc: An alternate host to hold the configuration storage; leave blank to use the already defined host.

Servers/1/controlport.name: Control port
Servers/1/controlport.desc: An alternate port to connect to the host that holds the configuration storage; leave blank to use the default port, or the already defined port, if the controlhost equals host.

Servers/1/controluser.name: Control user
Servers/1/controluser.desc: A special MySQL user configured with limited permissions, more information available on [doc@linked-tables]documentation[/doc].

Servers/1/bookmarktable.name: Bookmark table
Servers/1/bookmarktable.desc: Leave blank for no [doc@bookmarks@]bookmark[/doc] support, suggested: [kbd]pma__bookmark[/kbd]

Servers/1/relation.name: Relation table
Servers/1/relation.desc: Leave blank for no [doc@relations@]relation-links[/doc] support, suggested: [kbd]pma__relation[/kbd].

Servers/1/userconfig.name: User preferences storage table
Servers/1/userconfig.desc: Leave blank for no user preferences storage in database, suggested: [kbd]pma__userconfig[/kbd].

Servers/1/users.name: Users table
Servers/1/users.desc: Both this table and the user groups table are required to enable the configurable menus feature; leaving either one of them blank will disable this feature, suggested: [kbd]pma__users[/kbd].

Servers/1/usergroups.name: User groups table
Servers/1/usergroups.desc: Both this table and the users table are required to enable the configurable menus feature; leaving either one of them blank will disable this feature, suggested: [kbd]pma__usergroups[/kbd].

Servers/1/navigationhiding.name: Hidden navigation items table
Servers/1/navigationhiding.desc: Leave blank to disable the feature to hide and show navigation items, suggested: [kbd]pma__navigationhiding[/kbd].

Servers/1/table_info.name: Display columns table
Servers/1/table_info.desc: Table to describe the display columns, leave blank for no support; suggested: [kbd]pma__table_info[/kbd].

Servers/1/column_info.name: Column information table
Servers/1/column_info.desc: Leave blank for no column comments/media types, suggested: [kbd]pma__column_info[/kbd].

Servers/1/history.name: SQL query history table
Servers/1/history.desc: Leave blank for no SQL query history support, suggested: [kbd]pma__history[/kbd].

Servers/1/recent.name: Recently used table
Servers/1/recent.desc: Leave blank for no "persistent" recently used tables across sessions, suggested: [kbd]pma__recent[/kbd].

Servers/1/favorite.name: Favorites table
Servers/1/favorite.desc: Leave blank for no "persistent" favorite tables across sessions, suggested: [kbd]pma__favorite[/kbd].

Servers/1/table_uiprefs.name: UI preferences table
Servers/1/table_uiprefs.desc: Leave blank for no "persistent" tables' UI preferences across sessions, suggested: [kbd]pma__table_uiprefs[/kbd].

Servers/1/tracking.name: SQL query tracking table
Servers/1/tracking.desc: Leave blank for no SQL query tracking support, suggested: [kbd]pma__tracking[/kbd].

Servers/1/table_coords.name: Designer and PDF schema: table coordinates
Servers/1/table_coords.desc: Leave blank for no PDF schema support, suggested: [kbd]pma__table_coords[/kbd].

Servers/1/pdf_pages.name: PDF schema: pages table
Servers/1/pdf_pages.desc: Leave blank for no PDF schema support, suggested: [kbd]pma__pdf_pages[/kbd].

Servers/1/central_columns.name: Central columns table
Servers/1/central_columns.desc: Leave blank for no central columns support, suggested: [kbd]pma__central_columns[/kbd].

Servers/1/export_templates.name: Export templates table
Servers/1/export_templates.desc: Leave blank for no export template support, suggested: [kbd]pma__export_templates[/kbd].

Servers/1/MaxTableUiprefs.name: Maximal number of table preferences to store
Servers/1/MaxTableUiprefs.desc: Limits number of table preferences which are stored in database, the oldest records are automatically removed.

Servers/1/tracking_version_auto_create.name: Automatically create versions
Servers/1/tracking_version_auto_create.desc: Whether the tracking mechanism creates versions for tables and views automatically.

Servers/1/tracking_default_statements.name: Statements to track
Servers/1/tracking_default_statements.desc: Defines the list of statements the auto-creation uses for new versions.

Servers/1/tracking_add_drop_view.name: Add DROP VIEW
Servers/1/tracking_add_drop_view.desc: Whether a DROP VIEW IF EXISTS statement will be added as first line to the log when creating a view.

Servers/1/tracking_add_drop_table.name: Add DROP TABLE
Servers/1/tracking_add_drop_table.desc: Whether a DROP TABLE IF EXISTS statement will be added as first line to the log when creating a table.

Servers/1/tracking_add_drop_database.name: Add DROP DATABASE
Servers/1/tracking_add_drop_database.desc: Whether a DROP DATABASE IF EXISTS statement will be added as first line to the log when creating a database.

ShowSQL.name: Show SQL queries
ShowSQL.desc: Defines whether SQL queries generated by phpMyAdmin should be displayed.

Confirm.name: Confirm DROP queries
Confirm.desc: Whether a warning ("Are your really sure…") should be displayed when you're about to lose data.

QueryHistoryMax.name: Query history length
QueryHistoryMax.desc: How many queries are kept in history.
QueryHistoryMax.cmt: Users cannot set a higher value

IgnoreMultiSubmitErrors.name: Ignore multiple statement errors
IgnoreMultiSubmitErrors.desc: If enabled, phpMyAdmin continues computing multiple-statement queries even if one of the queries failed.

MaxCharactersInDisplayedSQL.name: Maximum displayed SQL length
MaxCharactersInDisplayedSQL.desc: Maximum number of characters used when a SQL query is displayed.

RetainQueryBox.name: Retain query box
RetainQueryBox.desc: Defines whether the query box should stay on-screen after its submission.

CodemirrorEnable.name: Enable CodeMirror
CodemirrorEnable.desc: Use user-friendly editor for editing SQL queries (CodeMirror) with syntax highlighting and line numbers.

LintEnable.name: Enable linter
LintEnable.desc: Find any errors in the query before executing it. Requires CodeMirror to be enabled.

EnableAutocompleteForTablesAndColumns.name: Enable autocomplete for table and column names
EnableAutocompleteForTablesAndColumns.desc: Autocomplete of the table and column names in the SQL queries.

DefaultForeignKeyChecks.name: Foreign key checks
DefaultForeignKeyChecks.desc: Default value for foreign key checks checkbox for some queries.

QueryHistoryDB.name: Permanent query history
QueryHistoryDB.desc: Enable if you want DB-based query history (requires phpMyAdmin configuration storage). If disabled, this utilizes JS-routines to display query history (lost by window close).

AllowSharedBookmarks.name: Allow shared bookmarks between users
AllowSharedBookmarks.desc: Allow users to create bookmarks that are available for all other users
